text: Watch Lex Fridman's interview with Musk ( [VIDEO] ), where they discuss exactly this topic. Furthermore (regarding some other children here), the study that Lex and his team has done show that drivers are not less engaged while Autopilot is on (as many critics say).

While you're waiting for the main event to start, here are some recent interviews with Elon about self-driving cars. He's very confident.
